verdict.rationale: Flagright documents case management for centralizing investigations, a case-creation endpoint, case statuses and filters, and alert retrieval with status values, so the core investigation workflow exists. Nothing shows how alerts are prioritized or how subjects and transactions are grouped into a case. missing for 10: alert prioritization/priority scoring, documented grouping of users and transactions into a case, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can prioritize alerts and group relevant subjects and transactions into an investigation

citations.quote: Case Management - Centralize investigations with AI-native workflows.
